title: Client portal access and invitations
summary: Invite clients, control what they see, and revoke project access.
excerpts: To invite a client, open a project, select Client Portal, and enter their email address. They open the portal with a one-time sign-in link that expires after 15 minutes. Clients do not need a LumenDesk account.
Clients can see published proposals, scope, updates, and payment status in their project portal. Internal drafts and notes stay in the studio workspace.
Workspace owners and admins can revoke a client's access from the project's Client Portal settings. Client guests do not use seats on any paid plan.
